mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers investor confidence in labor market stability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signals a balanced economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO rises >3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 60d horizon when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise by >5% and >3% respectively in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates and elevated CPIAUCSL values during a late-cycle expansion indicate loose monetary policy and inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <3.5% and CPIAUCSL >305 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates coupled with falling unemployment rates signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative over 20d when FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.2% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand measured by HOUST exceeding 1500 units in a month signals heightened investor activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positive in >60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1500 units in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the INDPRO index reflects expanding production capacity, which positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 20d when INDPRO increases (Pearson correlation <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and UNRATE falls >0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive over 60d when GDPC1 rises >5% and UNRATE falls >0.3% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
